note.after_visit_summary: You have a bacterial sinus infection causing facial pain, pressure, thick green nasal discharge, and fever. You are allergic to penicillin, so we prescribed Darcocycline 100 mg twice daily for 7 days. Take it with a full glass of water and stay upright for 30 minutes after each dose. Use sunscreen as this medicine can make you sunburn easily. Stop using Afrin nasal spray, as it can worsen congestion after 3 days. Instead, use a saline rinse twice daily and Fludacassone nasal spray: two sprays in each nostril once daily. You may continue ibuprofen 400 mg up to three times a day with food for pain or fever. A work note has been provided for Monday through today. If you do not start feeling better in 3 days, or if you develop swelling around your eyes, vision changes, stiff neck, or severe headache, call us right away or go to the emergency room. We will call you at 555 -0129 if there are any changes to your prescription. Otherwise, only return if symptoms are not improving.
